confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors triangulate search-result summaries of several aggregated or crowd-sourced sources dated roughly 2023 to 2026. Cocktail and wine anchors lack a citywide aggregate, so they use venue and guide price ranges cross-checked against the beer anchor and are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation search was run and no listings or booking pages were checked. FX is stale: the only RBA-page figure reported in search results is dated 2026-03-20, not the 2026-11-19 generation date. A third-party site's 2026-10-27 figure was not used because it is not an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are city-specific, from search-result summaries of aggregated and crowd-sourced price sources; cocktail and wine also draw on venue menus and guide ranges. Dinar prices were converted at the dinar's fixed USD peg. Accommodation anchors reflect general Middle East capital-city hotel norms.
